assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Premises type
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: What type of premises will be used to prepare and/or store food at the site of the event? Check all that apply.
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: A temporary food booth (e.g. tables & tents) A permitted mobile food preparation trailer or cart (e.g. hot dog cart) A self-contained unit/kiosk Premises will be located outdoors Tent/umbrella/canopy will be used Premises will be located indoors
